style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: he is in flight in frame one and never perches, the loft streaming past him every beat; the camera tracks alongside him to a new shot size each beat, reversing at 1.25, 3.85 and 6.90; his face never under a third of frame and never filling the glass, beak visible
character: a huge grey northern owl, grey facial discs, yellow eyes, no ear tufts, face and beak clear
second_characters: A SWARM of mice in rust-red coats pouring out of the bins with his coins, ONE a wing from the lens every beat, two in the first second; all moving
props: ONE felt hat with a peacock feather on his head from the first frame; A SWARM of walnuts and coins in every crack of the loft; ONE clay money jar, out of sight until 6.90
prop_continuity: the hat never leaves his head, the feather streaming back clear of his beak; the walnut in his talon from 0.00, hurled at the lens at 5.40; the jar exists only from 6.90
environment: a sunlit grain loft packed with bins and stuffed cracks a wing away, boards raking the lens
light_events: white noon through the boards, a hard rim on his hat

audio.delivery: a level male chest voice around 130 Hz, 4 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: na-ko-PLE-ni-ya, kog-DA, za-BYL, ot-lo-ZHIL, I-na-che, E-to, ot-LO-zhen-ny, ras-HOD
audio.pacing: speech fills 0.00-1.25, 1.55-3.85 and 4.15-6.90, first word on frame one; after 6.90 no spoken word, only his deep hoot and a short gek-gek call, wings and squeaks to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: his deep hoot and a short gek-gek call after 6.90, wings, coins, squeaks

timeline.a: he tears along the bins with a walnut in one talon, the cracks raking past a wing away, TWO mice crossing the lens
he slings the walnut back across frame and swings after it, the loft tearing past the other way
he tears across frame low over the bins, the cracks streaming past his head, A SWARM of mice pouring across the lens
he drives straight across the lens a wing away, beak wide, the bins whipping past, a mouse hurling a coin across the frame
he rakes back across frame the other way, the loft tearing past with him, a mouse skidding across the lens
a mouse slings the walnut across his path, he hooks it in one talon in passing and tears on across frame, coins out of the cracks
he hurls the walnut at the lens and tears across frame after it, the bins streaming past
A SWARM of mice launches off the bins across the lens with his coins as he rakes past them
a mouse slaps the empty jar into his talons in mid-air and he hurls it at the lens with a deep hoot
he drives his beak at the lens with a short gek-gek call, feathers and coins across frame
he dives along the bins after the rolling jar, coins bursting past the lens, a mouse riding inside it across the bottom of frame

must_appear: the hat with the peacock feather on his head in every beat; a mouse or a coin crosses the lens every beat; nothing touches him before 6.90; the jar hurled at the lens by 7.50; every word spoken, the last by 6.90; beak open on every syllable
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, night, dark scene, a static camera, a still background, a still first frame, a held pose, a perched hero, a hat blowing off, a feather across his beak, a wide or distant hero, slow motion, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed beak while speaking, anything touching him before 6.90, ear tufts, brown or tawny plumage, grey mice, foreign accent
